summary: Apogee Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K to announce that holders of its IPO units may elect to separately trade the underlying Class A ordinary shares, warrants, and rights starting May 28, 2026. No transaction or business combination is announced. This is a purely administrative step common for SPACs post-IPO. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor are mentioned. The filing is a routine current report with no special-situation event. Investors should monitor for a future business combination announcement.
